name: volume
description: Set or change how loud the Mac's sound is (volume or sound up, down, turn up, turn down, raise, lower, crank, bump, boost, louder, quieter, softer, max, silence, mute or unmute) — also when it's too loud or they can't hear it.

args.name: level
args.description: 0-100 to set it to; max or full = 100, half = 50, lowest = 0

args.name: change
args.description: how much up (+) or down (-) when no exact level is given, e.g. 10 or -10

args.name: muted
args.description: true to mute, false to unmute

name: media
description: Control the music or video that's playing: play, hit play, pause, stop, resume, continue, next or previous track, skip, go back to the last song, play it again.

name: dark_mode
description: Turn the Mac's dark mode (dark theme / dark screen appearance) on, or switch to light mode.

name: open_app
description: Open, launch, start, fire up, pull up or bring up a Mac app by its name.

name: find_file
description: Find, locate, open or pull up one of the user's own files, documents or folders (where is my …, where did I save …).

args.name: query
args.description: what to look for, in the user's words

name: calculate
description: Work out arithmetic: how much is, plus, minus, times, multiply, divide, divided by, percent of, squared, square root, to the power of.

args.name: expression
args.description: the math with digits and + - * / ^ ( ), e.g. 2*3*4 or 0.15*80

name: time
description: Tell the current time, the day, today's date, the month or the year.
